notes: GODS OF IMD on Ethereum. OracleShrine(owner_, intake_, imd_, oracleSigner_, director_): $owner; IMD Intake v2; the IMD token on this chain; IMD's oracle attester; the game server wallet (director). GodsOfIMDInhabitants(owner_, imd_, shrine_, burnSink_): $owner; the same IMD token; $contract:OracleShrine; the burn sink. Both constructors only reject zero addresses and make no external call. Nothing is called after deployment: the owner sets the metadata URL, the steward, the payees and the mint phase from their own wallet.
